limitations: Only stated translational phases and the selected current STEP obstacles are covered; fixtures, cables, hoses and site equipment absent from STEP are not proven clear.
Rigid bag boxes are conservative geometric scenarios, not FEM cloth/petal simulation. They do not prove that cut petals fold, remain attached, avoid snagging or release from blades.
Intended bag/cutter/support contacts are measured and explicitly exempted by body/phase; their physical feasibility requires separate opening/emptying evidence.
Uncertified intervals remain unresolved; no sampled zero-collision result is promoted to continuous clearance.
No loads, bag swing, suspension compliance, stopping distance, material flow, dust capture or precision dosing simulation is claimed.
Only the listed declared_mechanism_sweeps are covered for pin/access/clamp/roller/gate mechanisms; missing phases are not inferred from the high-level process animation.
Pitch-changing springs and the nonlinear cam-release contact locus require separate BRep/containment verification; they are not certified by the rigid mechanism translation sweep.
